display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Supported browsers:
Firefox, Waterfox, LibreWolf,
Pale Moon, Thunderbird, Zen...

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
For each profile found,
locate the browser's
install folder

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Load nss3.dll from the
install folder at runtime
This also loads its dependencies:
softokn3.dll, mozglue.dll

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Call NSS_Init with the
profile path
This unlocks the key4.db
master key database

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Read logins.json
Contains all saved
username + password pairs
as encrypted base64 blobs

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
For each login entry:
base64 decode the blob,
call PK11SDR_Decrypt,
get plaintext username + password

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Also decrypt cookies,
history, autofill, addresses,
credit cards from SQLite files
